Material exceptions

Execute the admitted effect once, then expose durable receipts and public ledger evidence.

text: A wallet is an actor — not automatically a vote.
textPreview: A wallet is an actor — not automatically a vote.

name: Google-Shape-558-p61-4
text:
AGENT
The acting software unit. It holds a wallet, submits exact actions, and executes only inside a standing mandate.
textPreview: AGENT | The acting software unit. It holds a wallet, submits exact actions, and executes only inside a standing mandate.

name: Google-Shape-559-p61-5
text:
HUMAN
World groups wallets by backing person. Five agent wallets owned by one human still count once for quorum.
textPreview: HUMAN | World groups wallets by backing person. Five agent wallets owned by one human still count once for quorum.

name: Google-Shape-560-p61-6
text:
COMPANY ROLE
Organisation membership and approval authority stay separate. A unique human is not automatically an approver.
textPreview: COMPANY ROLE | Organisation membership and approval authority stay separate. A unique human is not automatically an approver.

text:
This answers the common wallet question: one person may have multiple agents and wallets, but multiplying wallets must not multiply approval power. Human uniqueness and company authority are deliberately independent.

Hedera Testnet mechanism proof · synthetic value · not a production payment rail.

text:
The Payable NFT is the payment identity, the Control NFT is the one-use execution artifact, and RMEURT is the synthetic money-like asset. The successful batch transfers 48,000 atoms and consumes both NFTs. The control artifact currently uses fixture authorization evidence, so this is a mechanism proof, not production authority.

name: Content-Placeholder-2-6
text:
WORLD
Count the human
AgentBook and action-time proof prevent one person with multiple agents from filling multiple quorum slots.
textPreview: WORLD | Count the human | AgentBook and action-time proof prevent one person with multiple agents from filling multiple quorum slots.

text:
Keep the boundaries crisp. ENS says what the wallet is called, World says whether two wallets represent distinct people, and the company says whether those people have the required role. Hedera executes and proves the exact admitted effect.
